purpose: New 12-destination map painting; old map used only as style reference

Do not copy its old layout.

No text, letters, labels, numbers, pins, trails, UI, borders or boats. No background continents hiding extra destinations. Layout is critical. Coordinates below are percentages from top-left of the ENTIRE image, arranged in three rows of four. Each landform should be compact, roughly 12-15% of image width, distinct and not overlap. Upper row centers at y=17%; middle row y=49%; bottom row y=83%. Leave outer sea margins.

6 x=64%,y=49%: CIRCE'S AEAEA, densely forested emerald island, violet accents and a fine small Greek palace with columns.

11 x=64%,y=83%: CALYPSO'S OGYGIA, secluded fertile island with a beautiful beach, small house or grotto, flowering trees, calm warm sunlight.

Sea texture quiet enough for a readable world map. Each location's visual identity must read at small scale. No characters, no giant villain figures. Fill the actual picture area with this exact archipelago composition.
